necessary-source-component-exposed

invented-validity-rule
A new rule cannot replace the pre-existing SFT admission and domain laws.
preexisting-admission-and-domain-laws
Only prior model-admitted SFT laws govern the contradiction.
inadmissibility-asserted-without-negated-target
A label or missing receipt is not a proof of the registered validity negation.
assume-valid-and-derive-actual-contradiction
The proof assumes SFT validity and derives both a mandatory condition and its exact failure.
unexecuted-or-sampled-evidence
Every finite source, axiom, token, dependency and identity check must execute.
complete-executable-evidence
Every registered finite check is recomputed exactly.
native-proof-transferred-to-source
Proof of a different SFT-native proposition cannot validate the source artifact.
native-reconstruction-kept-distinct
